title: Awesome Revit Plugins
description: A curated list of plugins, add-ins, extensions, and developer tools for Autodesk Revit, split into open-source and paid.
intro: Awesome Revit Plugins collects the best free and commercial **Revit add-ins** for BIM and AEC teams. It covers **pyRevit**, **Dynamo for Revit**, **IFC and glTF exporters**, **Revit API** templates and samples, inspection tools like RevitLookup, and paid add-ins from the Autodesk App Store. Each entry links to the project and lists its license.
